CelltypeNetworkResult: cell-type-resolved cross-omic network

Source: R/AllClasses.R
CelltypeNetworkResult-class.Rd

Stores the estimated precision matrix, adjacency matrix, stability scores, and node metadata from run_celltype_network and run_exposure_network. Use the accessors in network-accessors to extract them, and CelltypeNetworkResult() to wrap a network estimated elsewhere.

Usage

# S4 method for class 'CelltypeNetworkResult'
show(object)

Arguments

object

A CelltypeNetworkResult object.

Value

The show method prints a summary and returns NULL invisibly.

Slots

precision_matrix

Numeric matrix. Estimated block precision (inverse covariance) matrix.

adjacency_matrix

Numeric matrix. Symmetric binary edge indicators (1 = edge present, 0 = absent) with the dimensions of precision_matrix and a zero diagonal.

stability_scores

Numeric matrix. Edge-level selection frequencies (0-1) across the XStARS subsamples at the selected penalties, for coglasso networks built with stability = TRUE. Empty otherwise.

node_info

DataFrame. Maps each node (row/col index) to its omic layer ("transcript" or "metabolite"), feature name, and optional module/community assignment. It has one row per node, in matrix order; when the matrices have row or column names, these must equal its feature column.

celltype

Character. The cell type this network represents.

method

Character. Estimation method: "coglasso" or "block_glasso" from run_celltype_network(), "exposure_restricted" from run_exposure_network(), or "precomputed" for a network supplied by the user.

metadata

List. Additional parameters: n_donors, n_features, lambda values, exposure, covariates.

See also

network-accessors, CelltypeNetworkResult

Examples

showClass("CelltypeNetworkResult")
#> Class "CelltypeNetworkResult" [package "exposomeSC"]
#> 
#> Slots:
#>                                                                           
#> Name:  precision_matrix adjacency_matrix stability_scores        node_info
#> Class:           matrix           matrix           matrix        DataFrame
#>                                                          
#> Name:          celltype           method         metadata
#> Class:        character        character             list
#> 
#> Extends: "CelltypeNetwork"
